description: A turnout on recent demonstrations organised by the Federalist Party was even higher than anticipated. Tens of thousands of young people gathered to chant anti-Matheuchellyan slogans, claiming that the Commonwealth's hegemony limits their development opportunities. Of course, they're just a very noisy minority, but it's worth noting how federalists have recently been placing emphasis differently, putting aside ideological issues and emphasizing the ambitions of the younger generation and the economy.

title: Nationalist wave
